turnaround_reason: INSP collapsed from $147 to the high-$30s on fears that GLP-1 weight-loss drugs would gut demand for its surgical hypoglossal-nerve OSA implant, compounded by 2026 U.S. coding/reimbursement pressure that pushed revenue negative YoY. The bounce is a re-rating as GLP-1 fear cools and profitability returns.
bullish_points: Q2 2026 beat and raise: revenue $200.6M (beat by ~3%), returned to profit, adj EPS $0.14; stock jumped ~23%; raised FY26 outlook and unveiled 'Project Horizon'
Management frames GLP-1s as a long-term tailwind (patients lose weight to qualify for Inspire), not a demand killer
Strong margins (85% gross), clean balance sheet ($321M cash, minimal debt), positive FCF ~$95M
Insider net buying over last 6m (+216k shares net, 24 purchase transactions)
Beat EPS massively 3 quarters running (surprises of +157%, +138%, +142%)
bearish_points: Revenue still declining -7.6% YoY on U.S. coding/reimbursement pressure — a real fundamental headwind, not just sentiment
Rich on forward numbers: forward P/E ~38 vs trailing ~13; much of the easy re-rating may be done after the +24% 30-day run
GLP-1 disruption remains a genuine long-tail overhang if drugs reduce the treatable-OSA funnel
Catalyst (Q2 print) already passed and is in the price; next hard datapoint not until November
Options open interest is thin (129 calls / 162 puts) — spot is the clean expression
catalyst: Continued proof that GLP-1 adoption is neutral-to-positive for volumes and that reimbursement pressure stabilizes, validating the raised guidance
catalyst_timing: Q3 2026 earnings Nov 2, 2026; ongoing GLP-1 adoption data through 2H 2026
suggested_trade: Starter spot position; prefer to add on a pullback rather than chase after the ~24% 30-day move. Spot only given thin options.
key_risk: U.S. reimbursement/coding pressure persists and keeps revenue negative, so the profitability rebound doesn't translate into growth and the forward multiple compresses.
would_skip_if: Revenue growth stays negative into Q3 or GLP-1 script data shows a measurable hit to Inspire procedure volumes.
